about:
Welk-Ko Fabricators Inc has operated from Livonia, Michigan since its founding in 1967. The company specializes in custom sheet metal fabrication and structural steel work, serving industrial clients across the region.

The shop provides in-house shearing, CNC cutting, forming, welding, and painting to produce NEMA-rated enclosures (Types 1, 12, 3R, 4, and 4X), test stands, brackets, plates, rack panels, chassis, cabinets, consoles, outdoor kiosks, machine guarding, and custom indoor and outdoor signs. It handles prototyping and short production runs, and also offers portable mobile welding and fabrication services for on-site work.

Welk-Ko’s enclosures and fabrications are used in electrical, automotive, and machine-tool industries, among others. The company notes that single- and multi-door enclosures serve a wide variety of sectors, with electrical, automotive, and machine tools cited as examples.

The company emphasizes customer retention, stating that over 90% of customers return for additional work. It promotes free estimates, a quick online quoting process, and a customer-first approach as key differentiators.
